span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Repeating sequences of transiently active hippocampal cells act as a time-based template onto which episodic memories are written and from which they are later read out, disambiguating memories that share a location
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Distance-coding cells must be reading self-motion (idiothetic) cues generated by the moving belt, so their firing is driven by sensed movement rather than purely by internal network dynamics
span.note: duplicate of: mechanisms[3]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the spiking of each neuron is fit to a generalized linear model including treadmill time, treadmill distance, spatial position, treadmill speed and spike history as covariates, and each nested model removes one or more categories of covariates
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the distance cells must be reading treadmill speed or the self-motion cues it produces, which is what rules out pure internal network dynamics
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: while the existence of time-only cells rules out pure path integration, so the hippocampus is holding both dimensions at once
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with distance encoded even though there are no visual cues of movement to read it from
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: due to the residual correlation between time elapsed and distance traveled, the paper cannot say with certainty whether neurons influenced by both were encoding both simultaneously or whether the hippocampus was shifting between types of representations
span.note: what this limits: the mixed cells specifically: WE CANNOT SAY WITH CERTAINTY WHETHER THOSE NEURONS ... WERE ENCODING BOTH TIME AND DISTANCE SIMULTANEOUSLY OR WHETHER THE HIPPOCAMPUS WAS SHIFTING BETWEEN TYPES OF REPRESENTATIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The experimental design cannot fully dissociate time from distance during ongoing treadmill running.
span.note: what this limits: the time-versus-distance dissociation the paper is built on: IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETELY SEPARATE TIME AND DISTANCE AS LONG AS THE RAT IS STILL RUNNING ON THE TREADMILL

span.label: the clamping of behavior and location was largely successful, although minor variations persisted, and were taken into account in subsequent analyses

span.label: elapsed time → distance
span.note: THE TWO CANNOT BE SEPARATED IN THIS STUDY - the DESIGN form of the negative relation (Q-286/Q-287). No edge type can express it: all eight assert that a relation HOLDS. Recorded here because a confounding statement BOUNDS WHAT THE PAPER'S OWN RESULTS CAN MEAN, and it lives in a methods paragraph where nothing downstream will find it. The confound is between the two things the paper's own title sets against each other, and it is the paper that ANSWERS Eichenbaum2014's question - so a reader joining the two needs this sentence and would never see it.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TWO VARIABLES CONFOUNDED IN EVERY EARLIER STUDY OF THE PHENOMENON: when animals stayed in a constant location, ELAPSED TIME WAS CONFOUNDED WITH THE DISTANCE TRAVELLED - the number of steps taken - so the whole time-cell result was open to a path-integration reading
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the design answer stated as a verb - CLAMP behavior and location, and vary the treadmill speed so that time and distance come apart
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE DECOUPLING IS DECLARED INCOMPLETE: it is IMPOSSIBLE to completely separate time and distance as long as the rat is still running - the effect of speed grows as the run proceeds
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: WITH THE CONSEQUENCE FOR THE FIGURES ADMITTED: the most visually distinct examples typically fire AT THE END of the treadmill run, because that is where the method has power - the examples shown are selected by where the design can see
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the residual correlation is carried into the conclusion - the paper CANNOT SAY WITH CERTAINTY whether mixed cells encode both dimensions or switch between them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE CLAMP IS REPORTED AS PARTIAL, NOT AS ACHIEVED: clamping was LARGELY SUCCESSFUL, although minor variations persisted and were taken into account in the analyses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A FIRING-RATE THRESHOLD DEFINES A CELL CLASS: units averaging more than 8 Hz over the session were considered putative interneurons and EXCLUDED - the category is a number, applied before any analysis
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TWO METHODS WITH DIFFERENT ASSUMPTIONS, MADE TO AGREE ON PURPOSE: a nonparametric spatial look-up table and a five-parameter GLM, correlating at r = 0.49 - so the conclusion DOES NOT DEPEND UPON THE ASSUMPTIONS MADE BY EITHER MODEL
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the location account is tested by construction rather than asserted - if position sufficed, the predicted and observed temporal tuning curves would match; if the rat were stationary the prediction would be FLAT
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the outcome that nearly all neurons DID show spatial tuning, and location was still NOT SUFFICIENT to explain the firing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE POPULATION SPLITS AT BOTH EXTREMES: 42 neurons informative for distance but not time, 30 for time but not distance, 284 for both and 44 for neither
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the two extremes fire IN THE SAME THETA CYCLE, which is what argues for simultaneous representation rather than switching between them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (`ANOVA --operationalised-as--> time`) · ANOVA —operationalised-as→ time
span.note: RETRACTED: `ANOVA --operationalised-as--> time`. The span: 'Quotation withheld that 92% of neurons active on the treadmill (366/400) significantly changed their firing rate across time bins'. Time is a FACTOR IN the test, which is the opposite of the test being measured by time. A STATISTICAL TEST IS NOT AN OPERATIONALISATION OF ANYTHING. It is applied TO measurements; it does not constitute one. On this schema `operationalised-as` names a measurement or definition OF THE FROM ENDPOINT, so a test name in the `from` slot asserts that the test is measured by the other term. meta-claude, 2026-08-15, and MEASURED BEFORE BUILDING: five live edges carry a test name at an endpoint, all five are `operationalised-as`, and ALL FOUR WITH THE TEST IN THE `from` SLOT ARE WRONG.
